snippet.title: You can hunt or hide from your friends in this coop party game
snippet.description:
Barely Alive is an upcoming co-op survival party game focused on co-op survival, proximity voip, and borderlines silly pvp physics.

Play with friends or strangers in private and public lobbies.

🎮 Open Beta Now Live on Steam
The Open Beta is available now through Feb 9, 2026. Jump in, try the game, and help shape development with your feedback.

👉 Wishlist or play the Open Beta on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2982710/Barely_Alive/

Follow development:
https://discord.gg/ahMxS9Bb85
